summary: The rows file never mentions the r4/r5 cone-chain evidence in the same harness: plain move/turn chains of a cone are a silent wrong solid in the shipped translator (dVol up to 0.27), yet rows 5, 8, 10, 11 and 6 are 'supported' with no guard condition. Even the proposed guard still fails 3 of 360 fuzz cases against the dCom bar, and make-rows-r3.mjs rebuilds only 27 of the 28 stored rows, so the file is not reproducible by its own assert script. The pick-after-move rows (0-4) replay exactly as stored.

defects.problem: Silent wrong solid called supported: a cone (revolve-built apex solid) moved or turned repeatedly is wrong in the shipped translator (r5-conechain-moves.out: 22 of 100 plain move chains FAIL, dVol up to 0.27, dCom 0.157; r4-conechain.out cone 9/40 FAIL, join-with-cone 14/40 FAIL). The row text only tests a single move/turn of a cone and the s1 chain flag is dismissed as tessellation. The fix (rigid-motion invariant plus chain repair in translate-guard.mjs) is not named in any row, and no row has the condition that the page must ship it.

Even with the invariant and repair, the wide fuzz fails the COM bar in 3 of 360 chains (r5-conechain-wide.out: cone 2/120 and copies 1/120 'guard WRONG'; replayed gw1 dCom 1.68e-4, gw3 dCom 3.4e-5, gw2 3.0e-5 against bar 3e-5). Magnitudes are tessellation scale, but they are over the stated bar and no row records them.

Not reproducible: make-rows-r3.mjs builds 27 rows; the stored move-turn.json has 28 (row 11, compose, was added by hand) and every row carries an appended RE-VERIFIED paragraph that the script does not produce. The assert script therefore does not guard the shipped file. Also r4/r5 scripts and results exist in the folder but no row cites them.

Status 'wrong' for rows 0-3 and a contract 'refused' for row 4 depend on a guard not yet in the page translator; the pick-guard refuses 43 cases that happen to build correctly (stated cost, acceptable). Row 27 sentence 'could not be built by this engine' uses a generic word, not an engine name; fine.
